Contract ManageUserCRUDService::modifyUser(userid: Integer,name: String,address: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		user: User = User.allInstance()->any(o|o.UserID = userid)
	precondition:
		true
	postcondition:
		user.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		user.Name = name and
		user.Address = address and
		result = true or
		user.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		result = false
}
